offering_description.value: Supplies steering, driveline and brake-by-wire systems and motion control software to vehicle manufacturers. It designs, tests and manufactures systems in-house and integrates hardware, electronics and software for customers.

quotes.quote: We are a global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting. Our innovative product and technology portfolio includes electric and hydraulic power steering systems, steer-by-wire systems, brake-by-wire, steering columns and intermediate shafts, driveline systems and software solutions.

Our innovation is fueled by our in-house ownership of R&D, design, testing and manufacturing and our focus on global, cross-functional collaboration. In-house development and full system integration of hardware, software and electronics provides us with a competitive advantage as an agile, full-service supplier to automotive OEMs around the world.

primary_products.value: power steering and steer-by-wire systems; steering columns and intermediate shafts; driveline systems; brake-by-wire systems; motion control software

quotes.quote: We are a global leading motion control technology company accelerating mobility to be safe, green and exciting. Our innovative product and technology portfolio includes electric and hydraulic power steering systems, steer-by-wire systems, brake-by-wire, steering columns and intermediate shafts, driveline systems and software solutions.

Nexteer’s MotionIQ software suite is the intelligence powering our ‘Motion-by-Wire’ technology portfolio – including Steer-by-Wire (SbW), Rear-Wheel Steering (RWS), and Brake-by-Wire (BbW) – as well as our industry-leading Electric Power Steering (EPS) systems.

primary_services.value: custom motion control engineering; embedded software development; systems integration; testing and validation

quotes.quote: We work with our customers to develop tailored solutions to solve motion control challenges across all megatrends. We’re committed to developing industry-leading motion control solutions that enable advanced safety, performance and convenience for today and an increasingly electrified, connected and automated future.

With decades of expertise in developing and integrating safety-critical embedded software, Nexteer’s global team of engineers act as an extension of our customer’s teams to accelerate speed-to-market and drive efficiencies. We focus on delivering end-to-end software development, integration, validation and more with agility, responsiveness and quality for our customers.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Passenger car, commercial vehicle and off-road vehicle manufacturers

quotes.quote: We solve motion control challenges across all megatrends – including electrification, software/connectivity, ADAS/automated driving and shared mobility – for multiple customers around the world including BMW, Ford, GM, RNM, Stellantis and VW, as well as automakers in India and China including BYD, Chery, Great Wall, Geely, Xpeng and others.

Engineered on proven algorithms deployed in over 115 million vehicles worldwide, MotionIQ software streamlines chassis control, development and vehicle health-monitoring workflows into a single suite, delivering significant cost and time savings for OEMs across the automotive, off-road, commercial vehicle and other adjacent mobility sectors.
